description: This file defines a class 'NotIn' that implements a validation rule to check if a given input value is not within a specified array of values (haystack). The class inherits from AbstractRule and provides logic to perform the validation, optionally using strict comparison.

classes.name: NotIn
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an input value is not in a predefined list of values (haystack). It supports strict comparison based on the 'compareIdentical' flag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the haystack array and the compareIdentical flag for strict comparison.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation check to ensure the input is not in the haystack, considering strict comparison if set.
